text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While searching for No Reason,
who hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Trainer!
I was caught in the midst of a battle!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: A sneak attack from a bug, catching me completely off guard! When I opened the window to let it out, even more bugs flew in...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd even call for reinforcements... formidable.
Thanks to that, it was dragged into a battle of attrition,
and look at the state of me now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While some parts were unavoidable,
I gave a warning to be more careful in the future.
